heading: Recordkeeping
lead: A recipient of assistance under this division shall keep—

tree.text: such records as the Secretary shall prescribe, including records that fully disclose—

children.text: the disposition by the recipient of the proceeds of the assistance;
the total cost of the project or undertaking in connection with which the assistance is given or used; and
the amount and nature of that portion of the cost of the project or undertaking supplied by other sources; and

tree.text: such other records as will facilitate an effective audit.
